_note: Cinematic theme master clock — content follows 'Jakubee Toothpaste script (source)' in README.md. Durations are seconds start-to-start; a transition overlaps the end of the previous scene. 40 s cut on a 90 BPM grid: every duration is a whole number of beats (2/3 s = 40 frames at 60 fps), so every scene change lands on the beat. Scenes play at their authored speed (smooth camera moves); the cut only trims the hold at the end of each scene. 'speed' > 1 would play a scene faster. scripts/generate-cinematic-soundtrack.mjs reads this file, so the music and sound effects always follow the picture.
